name: Intra Balance Movement Query V 02
definition: The IntraBalanceMovementQuery message is sent from an account owner/requestor to a settlement infrastructure to query intra-balance movement instructions, along with their current status, based on a set of search criteria.|The message may also be used to: |- re-send a message sent by the account owner to the account servicer (the sub-function of the message is "Duplicate") |- provide a third party with a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy") |- re-send to a third party a copy of a message being sent by the account owner for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy Duplicate").
